mapper.select: SELECT FROM faq_item WHERE ORDER BY is_top DESC,updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faq_item f INNER JOIN faq_category c ON c.id=f.category_id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.status='ENABLED' AND (f.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.question LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND f.category_id=#{categoryId}
SELECT FROM faq_item f INNER JOIN faq_category c ON c.id=f.category_id WHERE f.public_id=#{publicId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.status='ENABLED' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM faq_item WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_item SET category_id=#{item.categoryId},title=#{item.title},question=#{item.question},answer=#{item.answer},summary=#{item.summary},keywords=#{item.keywords},is_top=#{item.isTop},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{item.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE faq_item SET status=#{status},published_at=#{publishedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
